prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
On August 16, 2026, at Mazda Stadium, Hanshin took control almost at once.

In the first inning, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field. Hanshin took an early lead and had a simple plan: protect it, then look for more.

Starting pitcher Rito Ihara did the first part. He worked five innings, allowing only two hits and one run. Hiroshima's only run came in the fifth, when Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run.

That did not change the game's direction. Hanshin added runs in the seventh and eighth innings. The early lead grew, while Hiroshima could not build another scoring attack.

The final score was Hanshin 8, Hiroshima 1.

This was not a win created by one powerful swing alone. Hanshin struck first, limited Hiroshima's scoring, and kept adding runs late in the game.

【Point One】
The first-inning home run mattered because it gave Ihara room to work. In his five innings, Hiroshima did not put together a long scoring attack: only two hits and one run. So when Hiroshima scored, Hanshin was still in control. The later runs protected the lead; they did not save Hanshin from defeat.

【Point Two】
After Montero's solo home run, Hanshin answered with several contributors. Seishiro Sakamoto brought in runs with hits in the seventh and eighth innings. Tora Fushimi, batting as a pinch-hitter, also brought in a run in the seventh. The finish showed that Hanshin's attack was not resting on Sato alone.
